metadata.title: Bazaar Web3 — Crypto-Powered C2C Marketplace
metadata.description: Frontend prototype of a C2C marketplace for crypto-native communities. Mock USDT/ETH escrow on Sepolia testnet.

escrow.title: On-chain escrow
escrow.body: USDT / ETH escrow simulates the full flow with zero real funds at risk.

fee.title: 0% platform fee
fee.body: Free during the testnet phase. Listing and trading both cost nothing.

testnet.title: Sepolia testnet
testnet.body: Every transaction runs on Sepolia. Practice with zero downside.

wallet.title: Wallet-first
wallet.body: No email signup. Connect a wallet to browse, list, and buy.

favorites.title: No favorites yet
favorites.description: Tap the heart on any listing and it'll show up here, newest first.

noResults.title: No matches
noResults.description: Try a different keyword, switch category, or clear the filters.

noOrders.title: No orders yet
noOrders.description: Browse the listings, pick a few, and your buys will land here.

noPublished.title: You haven't listed anything
noPublished.description: Put your unused items, accounts, code, or domains up for sale.

footer.tagline: Prototype demo · Sepolia testnet · zero real funds
